text:
lena: Quick kickoff - were doing a micro-launch on Tue for the InferOps webinar. Need short-copy for X + LI, images, and a seedlist for SDR. Can someone take scheduling?
noah: I can schedule. Propose 3 touch windows: 9:00 PT primer, 10:50 PT main thread, Wed 9:00 follow-up.
diego: Ill draft 3 tweet variants: quick-tease, data-first, and CTA-heavy. Need one-pager for facts.
katie: Creative: what assets do you want? Static banner, 4:5 image for LI, and a 3-slide GIF for X?\lena: Banner + carousel would be great. Also include the two benchmark bullets: "~30% lower cost" and "2x throughput at similar p99". Legal needs to OK numbers.
noah: Use tracking: utm_source=x_tweet&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inferops_apr2026&utm_content=primerA. Ill append.
diego: Copy snippets rough: 
- Tease: "Live demo Tue 11am PT - see inference that scales. Register short.link/io"
- Data-first: "Independent test: 2x throughput, same p99. Live deep-dive Tue 11am PT"
- CTA: "Ship reliable LLM features. Join our free playbook demo Tue 11am PT"
katie: Ill export 1200x628 + 1080x1350 crops and drop in drive. Any preferred alt text?
lena: Alt text: "Webinar: inference cost & latency optimizations" is fine.
noah: Scheduling checklist - copy variants, final creative per channel, short link, UTM, publish times. Ill slot drafts by Mon 4pm PT.
katie: Ill also make a 6-slide LinkedIn carousel from the deck and a 3-slide GIF for the X thread opener.
lena: SDR routing: @sdr-bot route registrants with utm_campaign=inferops_apr2026 to webinar-social queue and tag social_inbound.
sdr-bot: Routing set. Matches with utm_campaign=inferops_apr2026 -> queue:webinar-social, tag:social_inbound, owner_rotation:west-region-sdrs.
diego: Paid boost? Growth asked if we can run $800 on the data-first post. ok?
lena: Yes allocate $800 to X boost on data-first, plus $200 for Wed follow-up.
noah: Ill mark the Buffer drafts with "needs: legal" once copy is in. Lena please confirm benchmark wording and Katie will attach alt text.
lena: Will confirm numbers with research and update by EOD Mon.
katie: Uploaded images + carousel draft: https://drive.redwood/marketing/inferops_assets.zip
diego: Once legal OKs, Ill finalize copy and tag @noah for scheduling.
lena: Thanks all. Quick sync Tue 8:30am PT if we need last-minute fixes. :thumbsup:
